Package com.google.adk.agents

Class Context

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.agents.ReadonlyContext
com.google.adk.agents.Context
Direct Known Subclasses:
CallbackContext
public class Context extends ReadonlyContext
The context passed to callbacks, tools, and workflow nodes during an invocation.

Agent and model callbacks receive a CallbackContext, and tools and tool callbacks a ToolContext; both extend this class, so a helper that serves both, or a function tool's toolContext parameter, can take a Context. requestConfirmation() requires a function call ID, which only a tool call has, while requireNodeState() and the other workflow node methods require the context of a workflow node.
